# Attuning Our Lives With God’s Plan

### Brother Chidananda • Self-Realization Fellowship

Welcome and blessings. Each of us has a sacred purpose in the cosmic play of the Divine. Brother Chidananda guides us on how to align our actions, desires, and decisions with the perfect plan that God has prepared for our spiritual progress.

### The Blueprint of Harmony

When we try to manage our lives using only the limited intellect of the ego, we often meet blockages and confusion. But when we surrender our path to Him, we are led safely through every trial. God's plan is always designed to bring us the highest spiritual evolution.

### Developing Intuitive Guidance

Through deep meditation, we cultivate the power of intuition, the direct perception of the soul. When the mind is perfectly still, we can hear the subtle guidance of the Satguru whispering the correct decisions inside our heart.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Consult the Guru:** Consult the Guru in your heart before making any major choices in your life.
* **Study the Teachings:** Meditate on the spiritual instructions in the SRF Lessons to guide your intellect.
* **Surrender Outcomes:** Do your absolute best in every situation, and then surrender the results to His divine protection.
* **Stay Calm:** When plans change, take a deep breath and say: *"Lord, thy will be done. I trust Thy plan is perfect."*

Jai Master! Jai Ma!
rawText: God has a perfect plan for our spiritual progress. When we surrender our personal worries and consult the Guru in meditation, our intuition guides us to make the right choices...
